repair_rationale: Run 004 proved the exact-turn conductor repair but exposed a broker admission defect. Eight scored affirmative items were requested and admitted as one block, so the item-five failure could not open its mandatory PRESENT_AGAIN boundary before items six through eight advanced the cursor. A failed lint command was also followed by append in the same operator shell invocation. The harness now rejects any teacher artifact containing more than one scored exercise while still permitting multi-turn models and unscored interface checks. The protocol now requires item-atomic scored brokerage and a separate fail-stop lint operation before append. The lesson, visuals, actor prompts, learner profile, scenario, scoring thresholds, and high conductor effort remain unchanged.
